about: Interaction (U24): the generated drive log on a restored 3D Field tab (Evergreen); the robot pose dragged from the sidebar into the source list, a selected time, an orbit drag and a wheel dolly on the canvas, then Orbit Robot and the KitBot's Front Camera chosen through main's set-3d-camera reply (what the camera menu's items send; the native menu itself cannot be clicked on either side). The drawing buffer is compared under gate 4, the rest of the window under gates 1 to 3, and the saved HubState (sources, camera state) at each capture
